effectSummary.ko: 회오리 1초 유지 후 유료 틱에서 1초마다, 3.5m 내 적을 최대 1.5m 끌어옵니다. 벽·몸체 앞에서 멈추며 보스·이동 불가 적은 제외합니다.
effectSummary.en: After Whirlwind has been held for 1 second, each paid tick pulls enemies within 3.5m up to 1.5m closer, once per second. They stop at walls and bodies, and bosses and immobile enemies are not pulled.

description.en: Damages nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds. Can be held while moving.

concept: A heavy crescent cleaver-sword with inward-hooked fang tip, deep spine recess and spiral-forged ridges converging at a bronze vortex boss. Blackened iron, chipped silver edge, oxblood leather grip. Diagonal, hilt low left, point high right.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one completely new HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon: LW01, Fang of the Maelstrom, a Warrior weapon for Whirlwind which pulls foes inward. The ID and name are metadata only: draw NO text.
Subject: one tangible heavy curved cleaver-sword, diagonal lower-left hilt to upper-right blade, with a very broad inward-hooked fang tip and a deep crescent recess near its spine. The blackened steel blade has two large spiral-forged sweeping ridges converging at a small old bronze vortex boss near the guard; these material structures suggest inward pull, without any floating cyclone or spell effect. Dark oxblood leather grip, chipped cold silver cutting edge, restrained warm bronze fittings. Make the curved fang silhouette unmistakable.
Style: painterly dark gothic game equipment art, convincing worn steel and rough leather, broad readable shapes, restrained detail, directional upper-left warm highlights and deep charcoal shadows. It should match an earthy aged-metal fantasy equipment atlas, never flat line icons.
Output: exactly 1024x1024 square PNG with NATIVE fully transparent alpha. One isolated equipment subject, fully contained within the central 76 percent of the canvas, at least 12 percent empty margin on every side. Strong solid silhouette readable when reduced to 64 pixels. All surrounding space and internal empty gaps are genuinely transparent. Preserve native alpha and clean antialiased edges; no matte or colored fringe.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, symbols resembling writing, watermark, UI border, panel, frame, badge, backdrop, scenery, floor, drop shadow, background gradient, checkerboard pattern, haze, huge magic effects, detached sparks, people or hands. Do not copy any existing game icon.
